scope: Primary sources for optional Windows mapped-file cache warming; no native experiment performed.

sources.supports: CompactedRegion reading opens the local file read-only; under LEAN_MMAP the Windows branch uses PAGE_WRITECOPY and FILE_MAP_COPY at the saved base address. It can fall back to allocation plus read. Relocation/fixups can make pages private. Source inspection does not prove which path the user's binary takes.
Module-data import tracks .olean parts and optional IR parts as compacted regions. This is not a contract for sharing a complete constructed Lean environment between separate compiler processes.
The loaded compiled-data parts depend on import/server/private requirements; not every artifact companion is necessarily used by every invocation.

Read-only views cannot write the file. Local views backed by the same file are coherent. Copy-on-write modifications become private pages. Mapping is virtual-address access, not a residency guarantee.
Pages may be shared between processes, faults may be soft when data is resident elsewhere, and Windows may trim working sets or repurpose cached transition pages.
Provides current physical-memory availability; values are volatile, so an initial free-RAM snapshot is not a lasting resource guarantee.

The Framework overload accepts FileStream, null mapping name, capacity zero, Read access, null security, no inheritance, and leaveOpen. Zero capacity uses the existing file length; zero-length files need explicit handling.

Accessing Process.Handle obtains a retained process handle; subsequent exit queries reuse it. StartTime is obtained from process times. The helper additionally checks exact floored UTC creation milliseconds.
Documents the managed mapping overload and zero-capacity behavior; the Framework source above resolves access-mode detail.
FileShare.ReadWrite and FileShare.Delete allow corresponding subsequent opens/deletion; these flags do not remove all mapped-file mutation restrictions.
Views must be unmapped and mapping handles closed before changing file size with SetEndOfFile. Scheduled-to-change project outputs must therefore be excluded from the warm manifest.
Locking is the stronger residency operation and can harm system memory availability. This candidate does not call VirtualLock or alter working-set privileges or limits.
